evidence.quote: Language requirements: All courses are taught in English; therefore, a B2 level English proficiency is required.
Costs: The tuition fee for this program is 7,000 USD/Year
Ensure your documents are submitted through the Online Application System before the deadline.

The following documents need to be submitted during the application procedure by all applicants through our online application platform - that you can reach here: Valid, filled-in application form (to be filled online here); If already graduated: certificate of education (school leaving qualification such as high school diploma, document of graduation or any equivalent; university degree certificate or any equivalent; all in English / translated); Students in their final year of education: transcripts (end of year reports) of the last 2-3 academic years, plus predicted grades / expected graduation certificate.
Certificate or proof of citizenship and/or permanent residence (e.g. passport)
Short Resume/CV (personal details, educational background, work experience, language skills, additional skills)

notes: Les frais de scolarité sont indiqués en USD et non en EUR ou HUF; la page des frais confirme uniquement que le programme fait partie des programmes non médicaux de langue anglaise, sans montant. Les dates limites pour 2026/2027 incluent le 15 juin 2026 pour les autres programmes, mais la page du programme ne donne que « 15th June » sans année, donc la date est récurrente. Certains documents cités proviennent de la page générale d'admission et s'appliquent à tous les candidats internationaux.
